name: Marlowe
source:
A member of a family of magicians who hate the Kingdom of Fordgilia and its knights.
Marlowe's ability as a magician is very high, his magic-related knowledge and skills are impeccable. Despite these strengths, his most prominent personality traits are sloppiness and laziness.
